subject: basic summary statistics table in poppr not exported

messages.author: c1c442e6047e735c
messages.subject: basic summary statistics table in poppr not exported
parts:
Hello,
I try to calculate the basic summary table for my genclone file where I could not ad stratification using the tutorial Population genetics and genomics in R.
My geneclone file is agc.

This is a genclone object
-------------------------
Genotype information:

     398 original multilocus genotypes 
     398 diploid individuals
   13960 codominant loci

Population information:

       0 strata. 
      29 populations defined - Ornamental_1, Ornamental_2, Ornamental_3, ..., OR7, ID1, ID2
When I run the code below, it does not return me a table of stats per population as in the tutorial table

> agc_diversity <- (agc_diversity <- poppr(agc))

##     Pop   N MLG eMLG   SE    H    G lambda   E.5  Hexp    Ia  rbarD   File
## 1    BB 113  94 94.0 0.00 4.40 61.7  0.984 0.755 0.584 0.591 0.0493 monpop
## 2    FR 581 191 66.6 4.17 4.58 53.4  0.981 0.543 0.588 0.809 0.0679 monpop
## 3 Total 694 264 73.6 4.33 4.89 65.0  0.985 0.486 0.589 0.729 0.0611 monpop

It only returns me the list of my populations and not the table, and it on
| Ornamental_1 
| Ornamental_2 
| Ornamental_3 
| Ornamental_4 
| Ornamental_5 
| Ornamental_6 
| Pervenec 
| Feral1 
| Feral2 
| Feral3 
| Feral4 
| Feral6 
| Feral7 
| Feral8 
| CO1 
| CO2 
| CO3 
| CO4 
| CO5 
| OR1 
| OR2 
| OR3 
| OR4 
| OR5 
| OR6 
| OR7 
| ID1 
| ID2 
Error: cannot allocate vector of size 8.2 Gb
Is there a way I could my summary table for my data? I have 398 individuals in 29 populations, and 13960 SNP data/genotypes.
Thank you,
Claudia

messages.author: d192ec4b1d416345
messages.subject: Re: [poppr] basic summary statistics table in poppr not exported
parts:
Hello Claudia,

You might want to consider using a genlight/snpclone object instead of genclone. If you imported your data from a VCF file, then you can use the vcf2genlight() in the vcfR package. Note that this will only work if you have biallelic SNPs.

Best,

Zhian
